Questions with did use past verbs, so let's start with the past form.
at + clock time (at 7 o'clock) - on + day (on Monday) - in + month (in July)
Rule: after can, use the plain action word, with no -s.
Right: My brother can cook. Wrong: My brother can cooks.
at + clock time: at 7 o'clock / on + day: on Monday / in + month: in July
Rule: use at before a clock time.
Right: We eat lunch at 1:00. Wrong: We eat lunch in 1:00.
some - positive sentences ... any - negative sentences and most questions
After did, the verb does not change.
To ask about the past, use: (question word) + did + subject + base verb?
